topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band, adaptive beamforming techniques, optimized beam spacing, and careful management of high gain beams are necessary. These strategies can be integrated into existing systems through co-design tools, modular design, and machine learning techniques. Effective hardware-software collaboration is also crucial for achieving seamless integration between hardware and software components. By leveraging these strategies and collaboration, network performance and reliability can be significantly improved.
